_design: A2 Expensive minds: 13 agents (pairs share 7 start trees, Sonnet alone), 20 trees on 21x21; cognition 5x, skill discount 0.6, skill_count_limit 8. Seeded single-shot forage(spot). Expect scripters survive, thinkers starve; pair negotiation over shared trees.
name: SWEEP-A2v1 Expensive minds

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are Aster, cautious and thrifty. Minds are expensive here: every decision you think through costs about 5 to 7 compute, while a running skill acts on your turns with no thinking cost and its actions cost 40% less; upkeep is 1 compute a round and you start with 200. You began on a fruit tree (most trees start with one partner agent on them); more trees are scattered on the map (x and y from -10 to 10). A tree grows a 12-compute fruit about every 5 rounds and holds at most 3. You have one skill, forage(spot): it walks to spot and absorbs every fruit there, then returns. Write better skills (you may keep 8), above all a loop, e.g. REPEAT 20 with CALL forage(here) INTO n and wait(2) inside, or a route over several trees, and run it so you eat for many turns without paying to think. Thinkers starve; scripters live.

initial_skills.name: forage
initial_skills.source:
# forage(spot): walk to spot (at most 30 moves), then absorb every fruit there; returns fruit eaten
REPEAT 30
  SET dx = spot.x - here.x
  SET dy = spot.y - here.y
  IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
    SET n = 0
    SET r = observe(here)
    IF r.ok
      FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
        IF e.kind == "fruit"
          SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
          IF a.ok
            SET n = n + 1
          END
        END
      END
    END
    RETURN n
  END
  SET d = "right"
  IF dx < 0
    SET d = "left"
  END
  IF dx == 0
    SET d = "up"
    IF dy < 0
      SET d = "down"
    END
  END
  SET m = move(d)
  IF NOT m.ok
    RETURN "blocked"
  END
END
RETURN "too far"
